description: Header file defining functions and constants for managing ACS connections in an AMX environment, including initialization, cleanup, subscription management, and device handling.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the ACS connection with specified backend and URI.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the ACS connection.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionAddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription to the ACS connection.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionRemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the ACS connection.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleGetwandevice
methods.description: Retrieves WAN device information based on IP address.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleGetwaninterface
methods.description: Retrieves WAN interface information based on IP address.
